note: Beulah Park District campground on the south shore of Lake Sakakawea (Corps land) north of Beulah. Electric, premium-electric and full-hookup sites in shelterbelt tree rows and open loops, plus primitive sites; roughly half the numbered sites go to a seasonal lottery. Sites 1-10 along Perch Parkway by the boat ramp look across open ground to the bay. Every rig backs in unless the office approves otherwise. Store, fish-cleaning station, boat ramp and dock, disc golf, swim area. --Claude
summary: Park district campground on Lake Sakakawea. 2026 season May 8 - Sep 13, online-only WebReserv booking; ~59 RV units online (33 electric $27, 13 premium $30, 13 FHU $35, 5 RV primitive $15) of ~111 numbered sites, rest seasonal lottery. Fees/booking/season/hookups/facilities written. Pin ~300 m off (on the houses south of the camp). Waterfront lead: lakeview for sites 1-10. Phone flag.
flags: PIN: stored 47.49850,-101.77300 sits in the wooded cabin/house cluster on the bay south of the campground. The campground's main block of tree-row sites (16-58) and the office lie at ~47.5012,-101.7733, ~300 m N; the north loops (59-111) run to ~47.5035. Move to 47.5012,-101.7733 (Google's pin 47.50358,-101.77413 is on the north loops).

WATERFRONT LEAD (upgrade): stored not waterfront -> lakeview. Sites 1-10 line Perch Parkway east of the office toward the boat ramp (pads at ~47.5025,-101.7680 to -101.7667); on imagery the water's edge is ~45-65 m south of the pads across open grass, a lower gravel lane and a sand beach - the lane rules out lakefront, the view is open. The operator: 'Electrical Campsite - better for small campers and great view of the water' (sites 1-10). Sold nightly: sites 3, 4, 7 (max 34 ft), 8 (35 ft), 9 (30 ft) and 10 are bookable on WebReserv; 1, 2, 5 and 6 are not listed online. Sites 28-58 are described as having 'a great view of Lake Sakakawea' but sit in tree rows ~150 m+ from the water: no value from them.

SEASONAL SHARE: the campground map numbers sites 1-111 (HHS registry: 100 units); WebReserv sells 59 RV units nightly (33 electric-only, 13 premium electric, 13 full hookup of the 24 numbered 77-100, 5 RV-allowed primitive) - about half nightly, the rest presumably the seasonal lottery ('Seasonal Lottery Campsites-2026 ... applications available December 1st - January 16th'). Not mostly seasonal; no discouraging wording. Google 4.3 / 98 reviews.

PHONE: stored 701-873-5852 is the Beulah Park District main office (Recreation Center). The campground's own lines: 'Beulah Bay Office Number: 701-873-5916' and 'Beulah Bay Cell Phone: 701-870-0602' (Google and WebReserv show the cell). Suggest 701-873-5916.

FEES: stored low $25 rested on 'Sites 6, 7, 8, 9 for smaller campers. Cost $25/night' (beulahparks text), but WebReserv sells 7-9 at $27; the $15 primitive units that WebReserv marks 'tent/RV' are the cheapest sites a 23-ft rig may use. The page's interactive map still shows older $23/$27 prices.
HOOKUPS: electric amperage is not stated for the RV sites (only 'Cabins offer 30 amp hookup'); electric left absent.

RULES: 'All campers must back into all sites unless approved by the Beulah Bay Office.' No Game and Fish or weekday camping ban applies (park district campground on Corps land). Quiet hours text on the page is garbled ('10:00 pm - 6:00 pm').
CABINS / GROUPS: 3 rustic cabins $50 and group sites A/B/C (4 sites each, $105) are not in the fees.
